name: Nebulix Emote System
summary: Four-slot emote wheel UI, preview rigs, server handlers, data-store scripts and an example animation/module.
install: Inspect in ServerStorage first. Move the CONTENTS of the named ReplicatedStorage, ServerScriptService, ServerStorage and StarterGui containers to those services; StarterPlayerScripts contents belong in StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts. Supply the missing Shared.Icon topbar library and game-specific Stats/Kills, SettingsFrame and remote handlers before enabling the complete system.
limits: Integration template, not drop-in working gameplay. Shared.Icon and MainGUI.SettingsFrame are absent; Topbar also references an unassigned settingsIcon. Reward/purchase/slot-change dependencies and remote validation need review. Data-store saving and emote playback are unverified.
credit: Original root credits Nebulix. Source filename and existing embedded attribution are preserved; authorship is not independently established.
verification: Edit-mode GUI preview only. Wheel/list visibility was set on temporary clones; scripts were disabled. No animation/reward/purchase/save test. Missing Shared.Icon, SettingsFrame and game-specific handlers are documented.
